capabilities.reason: Offline construction only: no model call, tool execution or external service verification.

input_schema.description: Nanobot.run arguments. This is a declaration of the Python SDK surface, not a new runtime JSON validator. Non-null hooks require Python objects.

attributes.description: Caller-owned context, kept separate from trusted message metadata; Python Mapping values may need serialization.

ephemeral.description: Controls session persistence/compaction policy; does not sandbox or roll back tool side effects.

message.description: User message; slash commands may short-circuit model inference.

output_schema.description: Native SDK returned value, including error-bearing or command returns. Not returned on raised/cancelled exits; presence does not imply business success.

content.description: Response text, or empty string when no outbound response/content is returned; no non-empty guarantee.
content.title: Content

error.description: Nullable captured diagnostic text; inspect together with stop_reason and content/history. None does not prove task success or rule out earlier recoverable tool errors. Non-null error can retain an earlier failure after continuation produces a later answer; it is not an exact classification of that final answer.
error.title: Error

messages.description: Captured runner message list; may be empty for command short-circuits. Not a guaranteed complete external event trace.
messages.title: Messages

metadata.description: Outbound metadata copied by SDK; arbitrary keys, not a stable business result schema.
metadata.title: Metadata

stop_reason.description: Captured runner status, nullable when runner hooks did not execute (e.g. command shortcut). completed can include refusal/content-filter text. After injection-driven continuation, an earlier error status may remain alongside recovered final content.
stop_reason.title: Stop Reason

tools_used.description: Authoritative after_run capture lists successful tool events; not a complete list of attempts or failures.
tools_used.title: Tools Used

usage.description: Captured provider token/accounting values; may be empty.
usage.title: Usage

output_schema.title: RunResult

responsibility: Nanobot.run performs per-call admission and optional MCP connect, then process_direct locks/restores the session, routes commands, builds context, runs model/tool iterations, persists and converts the result. Commands and exceptions skip later stages. Return is not background/global completion.
